# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first browser micro-tycoon called **Spell Dorm Tycoon: Real Bestie Simulator**. Preserve the original loop exactly: a 4x4 isometric grid, 600 starting funds, 300 build cost, 150 rent payout, a 5 second occupied timer, tool buttons for build/admit/reset, tap a tile to apply the selected tool, collect ready rooms regardless of selected tool, and show non-terminal feedback for blocked actions. Present it as a cozy satirical wizard-dorm tycoon with y2k/kidcore/decora colors, meme-tone copy, a magical dorm crest, procedural isometric suites, sparkly rent rewards, bubble-clean dirty states, mobile-safe HUD, and portrait-first readability.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: single-screen micro-tycoon / resource management game rendered on an isometric 4x4 canvas grid.
- objective: spend starting funds to build rooms, admit occupants, wait for the timer to finish, collect payout, then clean/reset the room for reuse.
- input model: one-thumb tap/click; tool buttons choose the action, playfield taps target a grid cell.
- core loop: Build empty lot for 300 -> Admit/check-in to start 5 second occupancy timer -> Ready state creates collectible rent worth 150 -> Collect makes room dirty -> Reset/clean returns room to empty room.
- fail/friction state: no terminal loss; invalid actions show feedback, and insufficient funds blocks building.

## Protected Mechanics
- 600 starting money, 300 build cost, 150 rent payout, 5 second stay timer, 4x4 grid, isometric coordinate targeting, state order, one active tool, tap to interact, and non-terminal blocked feedback are preserved.

## Remix Interpretation
The tycoon fantasy is re-authored as a cozy satirical wizard-dorm side hustle. Rooms become spell dorm suites, guests become tiny mages, rent becomes galleon-ish sparkle, dirty rooms become potion chaos, and cleaning becomes bubble reset. This changes presentation and meaning while preserving the exact economy and state machine.
